title: Sturdy but short hooks
text: Sturdy but short hooks. Good to hang on the back of a door because the hooks don't stick out very far. Buy we wound up replacing it because if you hang a wet towel on it, the towel will barely be dry the next day because the hooks are so short that the towel gets all bunched up.
